conversation.text: You said what is expected of you this week is unclear. What is happening?

Hai bot, actually a bit blur lah this week because my bus from Butterworth jammed and came super late this morning, plus walking into office felt like entering a freezer because the aircon is damn cold, need to wear thick jacket everyday! Anyway, already week three in AP already, but honestly everything is quite hantam-saja still because my SAP access only approved last week, and whenever I want to ask my team lead, he is always busy stuck in endless conference calls, cannot catch him at all. The work quota also damn high, rushing to clear backlog while trying to figure out things, but at least the canteen downstairs got very sedap nasi lemak, can eat to soothe heart a bit. But hor, the main headache right now is nobody actually briefed me on the proper vendor master rules, so many of my keyed-in invoices keep getting rejected by the system, meaning I have to waste so much time redoing everything from scratch, really dunno how to proceed properly without that guideline, hope someone can teach me soon lah!

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee reports high work quotas, delayed SAP access, an unavailable team lead during calls, and a lack of briefing on vendor master rules causing invoice rejections.
